[grafana] Fix default for automounting of SA token

In #571 / b6015e2 an option was introduced to optionally automount the
serviceaccount token. Due to an oversight at my part, I missed the fact
that a lot of people (including myself) use side cars for
dashboards/datasource discovery from K8S configmaps. So the default
should be to enable the automount of the SA token, to keep these
sidecars working.

Signed-off-by: Jorik Jonker <jorik.jonker@eu.equinix.com>

[grafana] Optionally automount SA token

It disables the automounting of the service account token in the pod.
Grafana itself does not need this. By disabling the automount, potential
attackers cannot access the Kubernetes API on behalf/through the pod.

commit.message:
Revert "Merge pull request #30 from jamesgoodhouse/add_envfromsecret_for_datasources_sidecar"

This reverts commit f4cd46e1a3994d7616208ad0c34eba0f8b57aa74, reversing
changes made to 31bc9e299058e62af11eb1a78089e856705d44fe.

This was an unnecessary change to allow envFromSecret to be used for the
sidecar for setting up datasources. It is not needed there, but instead
in the main grafana container that will consume the defined datasources,
and that functionality already exists for the main container.

Signed-off-by: James J. Goodhouse <j.goodhouse@gmail.com>

add envFromSecret parameter for datasources sidecar

Grafana config files [allow the use of environment
variables](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/provisioning/#using-environment-variables).
This change allows a secret to be specified for the datasources sidecar.
Its defined keys will then be made available to the sidecar via
environment variables.

grafana chart: Add option foldersFromFilesStructure

This adds a option `foldersFromFilesStructure`. It allows grafana to
replicate filesystem structure of json files in the dashboard.

More info about the feature:
https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/provisioning/#provision-folders-structure-from-filesystem-to-grafana
